cause: pricing.rule/apply-standard documents adding a flat charge of 20 but its implementation adds only 2, so a subtotal of 100 yields 102 instead of the expected 120.
evidence: The generated program (orders/place with subtotal 100) expected total=120, i.e., a charge of 20.
pricing.rule/apply-standard docstring: 'Add the standard flat charge of 20 to a subtotal.'
